models.name: Llama 3 8B
models.description: Llama 3 8B Instruct represents a monumental leap in small-parameter reasoning. Developed with a massive 15 trillion token training set, it achieved state-of-the-art performance across all industry benchmarks for its size. Featuring a improved tiktoken-based tokenizer with 128K vocabulary depth, it offers sharp precision in coding, logic, and creative instruction following. In Archer OS, this model is the 'Swift Unit'—optimized for real-time responsiveness and high-frequency tasks where 0ms perceived latency is mandatory. Despite its 8K context limit, its density of knowledge makes it a formidable unit for complex zero-shot reasoning.

models.name: Llama 3 70B
models.description: The flagship 70B variant of the original Llama 3 family, designed for deep semantic synthesis and high-fidelity reasoning. It utilizes the same 15 trillion token base as its smaller counterpart but with nearly 9x the parameter depth, enabling it to master highly technical domains like law, physics, and advanced software architecture. Utilizing Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) and optimized for 4-bit quantization, it delivers enterprise-grade intelligence while remaining accessible on high-end local workstations. In the Archer ecosystem, this model acts as the primary 'Logical Auditor' for multi-agent workflows requiring the highest level of fact-grounding and accuracy.
